Maya - Album 1: Preflight

All In

"Done playing it safe, I'm all in"

[Verse 1 - light ukulele, breezy and conversational] I’ve been playing it cool like I don’t even mind Shuffling through my playlist trying not to find Every song reminding me of something that you said Now I’ve got your name living rent-free in my head

[Pre-Chorus] I could keep the poker face a little longer But every hand I play just makes me want you stronger I tried folding once before, it didn’t stick Guess I’m not as good at this as I thought I’d get

[Chorus] I’m all in Done playing it safe, I’m all in You’re the hand I wouldn’t trade Best card I’ve ever been dealt Yeah I’m all in All my chips right here, I’m all in No more pretending that I’m cool When it’s you, I’m all in

[Verse 2] You caught me mid-bluff with that smile of yours Saw right through the shuffle to what I’d been storing Said “I’m fine” about a hundred times that week But you already knew what I was scared to speak

[Pre-Chorus 2] I could keep the poker face a little longer But every hand I play just makes me want you stronger I tried folding once before, it didn’t stick Guess I’m not as good at this as I thought I’d get

[Chorus] I’m all in Done playing it safe, I’m all in You’re the hand I wouldn’t trade Best card I’ve ever been dealt Yeah I’m all in All my chips right here, I’m all in No more pretending that I’m cool When it’s you, I’m all in

[Bridge - ukulele shines, stripped back] Wild card, you were never in the plan Funny how you ended up the best hand Ace of something I don’t have a name for yet But I’m done pretending that I haven’t dealt

[Final Chorus - key lift, full confidence] I’m all in Done playing it safe, I’m all in You’re the hand I wouldn’t trade Best card I’ve ever been dealt Yeah I’m all in All my chips right here, I’m all in No more pretending that I’m cool When it’s you, I’m all in, all in

[CODA] Like a four leaf clover, I felt lucky tonight But you used a spade, digging deep in my mind I’d trade all my diamonds to make you mine Then my heart skipped a bit when you said - All In…
